notes: New: Settings > Tokens - your own token vault. Add named tokens for GitHub, Cloudflare, Vercel, Firebase, Supabase, npm or a custom env var name. Values are encrypted with the Android keystore, shown only masked, and never sent to any model: prompts to chat.z.ai, transcripts, crash reports, logs and clipboard exports have token values (and common shapes like ghp_/glpat-) replaced by ***. A Test token button runs a read-only provider call with a plain-language result. After every task that had tokens enabled you get a Rotate-these-tokens card and notification with a per-provider button to the token management page; badges persist until you tap Rotated or replace the token, with an optional auto-disable after each task. Nothing is ever deleted without your tap.
